voice-branch-jargon.notes: [EXPIRED-NO-FIELD-HASH] Clean. No branch/audit working labels, bean ids, PR or branch names, AGENTS.md / skill-file or audit-memo pointers, dated status notes, or first-person work narration found in the .md body or the published .ts title.

trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of tbl:knot-operator-basis-table-table3-data. The block is a bare 5-row table with NO prose whatsoever, so none of the ten categories has any text to act on - all pass vacuously. VERIFIED the rows symbolically and against the cited witness.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: STRUCTURAL, reported separately, two items. (1) MATH ERROR: the last row L+ . sigma_0 . L- is given as (gamma=1, sigma_0=h, sigma_1=h, L+=h^2, L-=h^2, e-=h^3+h). The correct value is (0, 0, 1, h, h, h^2) - derivable in one step from the block's own sibling Table L.1, since L+ sigma_0 = e- and e- L- = sigma_1 + h L+ + h L- + h^2 e-; the witness photon-operator-table.witness.json T_{2,1} matrix[3][4] agrees with me (s1=1.0, L+=0.20906, L-=0.20906, e-=0.043706). The printed row is instead the value of e- . e-, i.e. it looks copied from the wrong product. The other four rows are correct. (2) Unlike its three sibling table blocks, this one carries no legend, so h, gamma, L+/L- and the b_i . sigma_0 . b_j convention are never introduced in the block.
